new_topics.label: New
new_topics.title: Agent privacy becomes a runtime governance problem
new_topics.what_changed: MLCommons released v0.1 of an Agent Privacy Risk Taxonomy covering data ingestion, aggregation and sharing, cross-agent policy inconsistency, runtime consent, and accountability, with benchmark development planned next.
new_topics.why_it_matters: Agent privacy can fail through memory, logs, tool calls and handoffs even when a model's direct response is safe, so deployers need runtime data-minimization and deletion-propagation checks.

updates.label: Updated today
updates.title: Decision models emerge as a separate AI systems layer
updates.what_changed: Cloudflare released Clef and Clef-flash as open-source typed decision models compatible with the Jev API, adding a second independent vendor implementation and open weights.

updates.label: Updated today
updates.title: Agents that overclaim task completion
updates.what_changed: Microsoft and Hugging Face released ThinkingBox, which grades terminal backend state and side effects across repeated trials and documents agents that terminate cleanly while leaving incorrect state.

updates.label: Updated today
updates.title: Agent safeguards tailored to the task
updates.what_changed: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three verified-access tiers with different safeguard levels, adding real deployment evidence for capability controls matched to user and risk context.
